title: Fabric HRIS — Write-Path & Network Observability (DEP-5 reference)
description: GENERIC REFERENCE ARTIFACT — no Grafana instance runs in this workspace (see deploy/observability/README.md). Panels map to DEP-5's four lettered requirements: (a) INT-5 partial-failure signal, (b) cert expiry across all orgs + per-tenant enrollments, (c) per-channel peer/orderer health incl. the ADR-0012 Raft-SPOF residual risk, (d) write-path anchor latency (NFR-9, placeholder pending QA-4).

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant channel(s)
list.description: Free-text/custom, not hardcoded to two — onboarding tenant N+1 (ADR-0013's O(N) fan-out) extends this list, not the panel queries. Defaults to the two channels that exist today per NET-7 (tenant01 has the committed chaincode; tenant02 has a channel + peer with no chaincode yet).

options.content: **GENERIC REFERENCE ARTIFACT (DEP-5).** Not a running Grafana instance — see `deploy/observability/README.md` for what is LIVE (real Fabric Prometheus metrics, once `metrics.provider: prometheus` is set) vs. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED (`writepath_partial_failure_total`, `writepath_anchor_duration_seconds`, `fabric_cert_not_after_seconds` — target contracts this item defines, producers owned elsewhere). Sources: `integration-design.md` §7, `security-architecture.md` T12, `implementation-backlog.md` DEP-5 row.

`writepath_partial_failure_total{tenant_id, profile_section}` — a counter incremented **exactly once** per `Hooks.OnPartialFailure` call, i.e. exactly when `anchor()` is about to return a `*PartialFailureError` (operational-DB write committed, blockchain anchor did not — `write-path-integration/writepaths/writepaths.go`). `profile_section` ranges over `writepaths.AllProfileSections` (PERSONAL/EMPLOYMENT/EDUCATION/ADDITIONAL/PAYROLL). NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — no producer exists in this codebase yet; this is the target contract for whoever constructs `Hooks{OnPartialFailure: ...}` in the real embedding process.

panels.title: Partial-failure rate by profile section
panels.description: sum(rate(writepath_partial_failure_total[5m])) by (profile_section) — labeled by the ratified five sections, per PRD §4 / writepaths.AllProfileSections.

panels.title: Partial-failure rate by tenant
panels.description: sum(rate(writepath_partial_failure_total[5m])) by (tenant_id) — tenant_id is NOT a callback parameter of OnPartialFailure(ctx, employeeInternalID, profileSection, version, err); it must be closed over from Hooks.TenantID at construction time, since one Hooks instance serves one tenant (writepaths.go's own Hooks doc comment).

panels.title: Partial failures, last 1h (all tenants)
panels.description: increase(writepath_partial_failure_total[1h]) — no reconciliation job exists to catch a missed one (PartialFailureError's own doc comment / INTEG §5.1), so any nonzero count here is actionable, not merely informational.

panels.title: (b) Cert expiry — all three orgs + per-tenant enrollments

options.content: `fabric_cert_not_after_seconds{org, tenant_id, cert_type, identity}` — NOT YET IMPLEMENTED (DEP-2's exporter/cron owns producing it; see README §2.2/§1). `cert_type=admin-signcert` is the operationally most load-bearing row — that is the identity the live Gateway client actually authenticates with (`crypto-config/peerOrganizations/<orgdir>/users/Admin@<orgdir>/msp/signcerts/...`), not the parallel unused Fabric-CA `hris-user1` test identity. Covers Org1, Org3, and every provisioned `OrgClient-<tenantID>` — not just tenant01.

panels.title: Days until certificate expiry
panels.description: (fabric_cert_not_after_seconds - time()) / 86400, sorted ascending — the soonest-to-expire cert first. Thresholds match alerts/alert-rules.yaml's 30d/7d boundaries.

panels.title: (c) Per-channel peer/orderer health — every provisioned tenant channel

options.content: All metrics on this row are **real, documented Fabric Prometheus metrics** (`fabric-skill-suite/corpus/fabric-docs-2.5/metrics_reference.rst`), LIVE as soon as `metrics.provider: prometheus` is set — no new code needed, only a config flip (currently `disabled` on every node, `network-docker-compose.yaml`). None of these carry an org/peer-name label from Fabric itself; `instance`/`job`/static labels come from the scrape config (README §4.3's illustrative snippet).

panels.title: Peer ledger height per channel
panels.description: ledger_blockchain_height{channel} — a peer stuck below its channel peers' height is the concrete per-channel 'peer unhealthy' signal. Expect tenant02's series to sit at a low, flat, non-crashing height (channel exists, no chaincode yet per NET-7) — flat-and-alive is not the same failure shape as flat-and-down; cross-check against the `up` panel below before treating either as broken.

panels.title: Orderer channel participation status
panels.description: participation_status{channel}: 0=inactive, 1=active, 2=onboarding, 3=failed, per orderer node per channel.

panels.title: RESIDUAL RISK — Raft consenter health per channel (ADR-0012, accepted not mitigated)
panels.description: consensus_etcdraft_active_nodes vs. consensus_etcdraft_cluster_size, per channel. cluster_size is fixed at 3 (all Org1-operated, ADR-0012). Quorum = 2 of 3; f = floor((3-1)/2) = 1. active_nodes == 2 is the tolerated single-node-down case; active_nodes < 2 means quorum lost — ordering HALTS on every channel this orderer set serves, network-wide, and only Org1 can cause or fix it. This panel exists specifically because that residual is accepted, not resolved, by having a dashboard (README §4) — do not read a healthy-looking aggregate elsewhere on this row as covering this case.

panels.title: Node liveness (up)
panels.description: Standard Prometheus scrape-target liveness, all peer + orderer operations endpoints. 1 = last scrape succeeded.

panels.title: No data yet — read before interpreting an empty panel as "latency is fine"

options.content: **This panel has no data source today and none is expected until `QA-4`'s Caliper harness runs (Fabric 2.5-bound, per `rencana-rekonsiliasi.md` §4.1) or real production traffic exists.** `writepath_anchor_duration_seconds` is a target contract this item defines (README §2.2) — nothing in `write-path-integration/writepaths/writepaths.go` times `anchor()`/`doAnchor` today. An empty graph here means **no producer wired**, not **latency under 500ms**. NFR-9's own PRD text: *"ambang awal — kalibrasi ulang setelah Caliper §10.4 butir 3 berjalan"* — the 500ms line below is that same provisional floor, not a measured result.

panels.title: Anchor duration p50 / p95 / p99 vs. 500ms budget
panels.description: histogram_quantile over writepath_anchor_duration_seconds — measures anchor()'s own wall-clock time, a proxy for NFR-9's 'added latency vs. no anchoring' delta since in-band anchoring (ADR-0014) is purely additive after the operational-DB save, as long as nothing else in the write path changes concurrently.
